metadataRaw.title: Easy Move for Quick Neck Arthritis Relief
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe demonstrates a simple exercise to help relieve pain, stiffness, and aches caused by osteoarthritis (also known as wear-and-tear arthritis) in the neck.

This exercise can be done at home, requires no equipment, and may provide relief in as little as 30 seconds.

Let us know how it works for you!
